title: FastD4RT: Training-Free Acceleration of Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2611.28193v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Query-based 4D reconstruction models such as D4RT encode a video once into a global scene representation and obtain outputs by decoding independent point queries. However, inference is often influenced by dense outputs and long videos. Although D4RT separates encoding from decoding, a dense output still requires one decoder query for every pixel of every frame, and a long video is still encoded as many overlapping segments. In this work, we analyze the inference cost of D4RT and show that a large part of it is redundant. In particular, we find that the later decoder blocks attend to a small set of tokens shared by all queries. Based on these findings, we propose FastD4RT, a training-free framework that accelerates D4RT. By exploiting the smoothness of the outputs over time and across pixels, FastD4RT encodes and decodes only at sparse anchors and recovers the remaining outputs via interpolation. translated_title: FastD4RT：免训练的动态4D重建与跟踪加速方法
translated_abstract: 基于查询的4D重建模型（如D4RT）将视频一次性编码为全局场景表示，并通过解码独立的点查询来获得输出。然而，推理过程往往受到密集输出和长视频的影响。尽管D4RT将编码与解码分离，密集输出仍需要对每一帧的每个像素都进行一次解码器查询，而长视频仍会被编码为许多重叠的片段。在本工作中，我们分析了D4RT的推理成本，并证明其中很大一部分是冗余的。特别地，我们发现较靠后的解码器块只关注由所有查询共享的一小部分token。基于这些发现，我们提出了FastD4RT，一个免训练的加速D4RT的框架。通过利用输出在时间和像素维度上的平滑性，FastD4RT仅在稀疏锚点处进行编码和解码，并通过插值恢复其余的输出。
tldr: 提出免训练加速框架FastD4RT，利用D4RT解码器中查询token共享的冗余性以及输出在时空上的平滑性，仅在稀疏锚点处编码解码并通过插值恢复其余结果，从而大幅降低动态4D重建与跟踪的推理成本。
en_tdlr: FastD4RT is a training-free acceleration framework that exploits redundant shared tokens in D4RT's decoder blocks and the spatiotemporal smoothness of outputs, performing encoding and decoding only at sparse anchors and recovering the rest via interpolation to dramatically cut inference cost for dynamic 4D reconstruction and tracking.
